children: Keurig agreed to sell its full equity stake in Chobani for $800 million and to sell an Allentown, Pennsylvania facility for $125 million.
Redeemed all indirect equity in Chobani for $800 million: $400M cash at closing and a $400M promissory note maturing Dec 26, 2026.
Sold leasehold, equipment and operations of Allentown facility for $125 million; Chobani to offer roles to site manufacturing and warehouse employees.
Transactions expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Chobani will co-manufacture certain KDP products at Allentown for a defined transition period to ensure continuity.
Proceeds intended to support Keurig's deleveraging and position Beverage Co. and Global Coffee Co. for long-term growth; commercial/distribution ties with Chobani are being expanded.
